# Set-ZbxGraphPrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a graph prototype.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxGraphPrototype [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixGraphPrototype>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-Discover <ZabbixDiscoverMode>] [-YMinItemId <ulong>] [-YMaxItemId <ulong>] [-Width <int>] [-Height <int>] [-YAxisMin <double>] [-YAxisMax <double>] [-ShowWorkPeriod <bool>] [-ShowTriggers <bool>] [-GraphType <ZabbixGraphType>] [-ShowLegend <bool>] [-Show3d <bool>] [-PercentLeft <double>] [-PercentRight <double>] [-YMinType <ZabbixGraphYAxisType>] [-YMaxType <ZabbixGraphYAxisType>] [-GraphItem <ZabbixGraphPrototypeUpdateGraphItemRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A graph prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one graph per entity it finds. The Set-ZbxGraphPrototype cmdlet changes the graph prototypes given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with graphprototype.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every graph prototype the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed graph prototypes back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a graph prototype

```powershell
Set-ZbxGraphPrototype -InputObject 'Space on {#FSNAME}' -Height 300
```

Makes the graphs made from the graph prototype Space on {#FSNAME} 300 pixels high.

### Example 2: Change a graph prototype and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxGraphPrototype -InputObject 'Space on {#FSNAME}' -Height 300 -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the graph prototype Space on {#FSNAME} back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixGraphPrototype>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixDiscoverMode`: Bound to -Discover (ByPropertyName). The discover mode values: ZBX_PROTOTYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ulong`: Bound to -YMinItemId (ByPropertyName), -YMaxItemId (ByPropertyName).
- `int`: Bound to -Width (ByPropertyName), -Height (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `double`: Bound to -YAxisMin (ByPropertyName), -YAxisMax (ByPropertyName), -PercentLeft (ByPropertyName), -PercentRight (ByPropertyName).
- `bool`: Bound to -ShowWorkPeriod (ByPropertyName), -ShowTriggers (ByPropertyName), -ShowLegend (ByPropertyName), -Show3d (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixGraphType`: Bound to -GraphType (ByPropertyName). The graph type values: GRAPH_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixGraphYAxisType`: Bound to -YMinType (ByPropertyName), -YMaxType (ByPropertyName). How a graph sets the minimum or maximum of its Y axis.
- `ZabbixGraphPrototypeUpdateGraphItemRequest[]`: Bound to -GraphItem (ByPropertyName). gitems of a ZabbixGraphPrototypeUpdateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixGraphPrototype`: The graph prototype read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
